[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Pretty simple, honestly! Just a recolor of The premium barn, coop and the winery from SVE using the cute valley colors![/color][/size]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Install Smapi! (obviously)
Install Content Patcher (double obviously)
Install SVE (why do you need this if you dont have it?)
(and all its requirements!)
And grab the cute valley mod! (and its add on buildings if youre supa cool!) (why else are you here except to match that tho..)
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]A little recolor for folks like me that have to have everything matchy matchy! [/color]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Smapi!
Content Patcher!
And SVE!
Also Cute Valley! (i mena.. you dont technically need it.. but why..)
